post.description:
POST + fetch streaming so the cookie/session and per-question method are preserved.

Progress events contain fixed status text/scores only, never question or passage text.
Instructor display-off suppresses progress and routing diagnostics server-side.

post.description: Is a local model server reachable, and does it have the model? Reads only its model list (G1-94).

get.description: Public. With a session: its token. Without: a short-lived anonymous token (also set as a cookie).

post.description:
Join a course with its invitation code (course-structure.md 3.3). Logged in (a student): the pending
membership with the account's e-mail becomes active. Not logged in: a new account is created for an
e-mail on the course list, every pending membership of that e-mail becomes active, and the new account
is logged in.

400.description: invalid code, or the e-mail is not on the course list

post.description: The creator becomes the course's first instructor.

409.description: the course still has students (end the term first)

post.description: Students from a CSV (`email`, optional `display_name`; other columns are ignored and not stored).
A co-instructor: an existing instructor account, by e-mail (an admin creates instructor accounts).

get.description: The current code's expiry and use count (not the code itself; null when there is none).

post.description: A new invitation code; the previous one stops working.

409.description: the module still has KCs or materials

patch.description: Change a KC, its prerequisites (the full list), or retire it (`status: retired`).
Edit an item; `status: active` publishes a draft, `retired` takes it out of use.

post.description: Content in the YAML seed layout into a course without content (one module per folder).
